question: 0.3.4: with MTP off - the setting that lets a 512K-cell q8_0 pool fit beside the Q4_K_XL model - how much of a decode step is host work and passes that grow with the context and the number of conversations, and can it go without changing a bit of the output? And can the RAM the server holds for checkpoints stop growing with every turn?
machine: GMKtec EVO-X2 class, Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (gfx1151), 128 GB, 96 GB carve
model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-IQ4_XS, MTP off unless stated
why: a user runs eight conversations at once with MTP off to fit a 512K q8_0 pool (MTP's draft KV and its pool-wide mask cost 4-5 GB there), saw ~10 GB of RAM in llama-server, and one conversation's decode fell from 26 to 20 tok/s between a short context and 110K

what.apply_idx_score_dec_034: the lightning indexer's decode block scores (12 layers) as one kernel reading each block key once from the F16 block-key cache, instead of GET_ROWS -> MUL_MAT -> RELU -> head sum -> visibility (-> membership product with several conversations), ~20 passes; bit for bit the chain's output: each dot product in mul_mat_vec_f's K = 128 order (64 threads a row, ggml_cuda_mad from zero, a butterfly in each wave of 32, the two waves reduced again with zeros), two threads a key. Also: a graph the scheduler did not split again (same cgraph, same uid) keeps its HIP graph key and compatibility check (~0.28 ms of host time a step)
what.apply_qsa_runs_034: llama_kv_cells tracks which sequences are one run (consecutive cells, consecutive positions, text only); for a ubatch whose sequences are each one run sharing no cell, set_input_qsa derives every input (block lists, limits, tails, block-key refresh lists, membership) from the runs' first cells and positions instead of testing every cell of the window against a bitset; qsa_scalar_visibility's window scan skipped the same way
what.apply_ckpt_budget_034: the context checkpoints of every slot share one budget in RAM (STRIX_CKPT_BUDGET, 24 by default, ~2.7 GB): over it, the slot holding the most (of equals the least recently used) gives up its least valuable by the per-slot eviction's measure, never its first, this task's last; disk-held checkpoints do not count

switches: STRIX_IDX_SCORE_DEC=0 / STRIX_QSA_RUN=0 / STRIX_CKPT_BUDGET=0 restore 0.3.3's way; STRIX_IDX_SCORE_DEC=2 and STRIX_QSA_RUN=2 run both ways and abort on any difference (with GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1); STRIX_INPUT_TIMING=1 logs each graph input's host time
